insights.deepseek_advice: For tweets sharing viral celebrity-bashing claims (citizenship forfeiture, passport denial, government blacklisting), search the exact claim text + 'fact check' first — these generate dedicated debunk articles quickly. Also check whether the source image has a self-refuting disclaimer visible in its text (like 'NOTHING on this page is REAL'), as that alone is Community Notes-worthy evidence that the tweet is spreading known satire as if real.
